cooldown.quote: {{dv|{{pp|3.5 to 2 by 0.05|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cooldown|label1=bonus resistances|formula= 3.5 - 0.0125 × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.}}|{{pp|3.5*2/3 to 2*2/3 by 0.3/9|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cooldown|label1=bonus resistances|formula= During All Out. 3.5 * 2 / 3 - (0.0125 * 2 / 3) × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.|showtype=false}}}}
cooldown.binNote: Base cooldown is a flat 3.5s at all ranks (bin cooldown: 3.5, BaseCD=3.5), but is reduced by bonus resistances down to a floor of 2s at 120 bonus resistances (MinCD=2, DefenseCapforCooldown=120), and further reduced by 33% during All Out (RCooldownReduction=0.33333). Recorded value is the undiscounted base.

castTime.quote: {{pp|0.45 to 0.35 by 0.01|0 to 120|type='''bonus''' resistances|label=cast time|label1=bonus resistances|formula= 0.45 - (1/1200) × bonus resistances, capped at 120 bonus resistances.}}
castTime.binNote: Bin lists castTime: 0.35 for the base slot, but the wiki's formula shows base cast time is 0.45 with no bonus resistances, decreasing to 0.35 at 120 bonus resistances (MinCastTime=0.35, MaxCastTime=0.45). Recorded value is the wiki's undiscounted base (0 bonus resistances).

values.meaning: slow amount applied to enemies hit

values.quote: '''K'Sante''' generates a {{tip|stack}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits

values.meaning: stack cap needed to empower next cast
values.quote: stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Ntofo Strikes'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect
values.binNote: No bin data value stores the stack cap as a plain number; KSanteQ#{9c9367bc} = 1xbuffStacks + 1xbuffStacks references buffStacks but does not carry the cap of 2 itself. The stack cap is presumably set on the buff definition, not in this ability's data values.

values.quote: pulls them towards him over {{fd|0.65}} seconds

values.binNote: Wiki states the empowered active's stun as 0.8 seconds, but the bin's KSanteQ.StunDuration is 1; this may correspond to a different variable, or the wiki figure is out of date.

values.meaning: All Out bonus cooldown reduction percent
values.binNote: Bin's RCooldownReduction is 0.33333; wiki rounds this to '33%' in prose. Recorded the bin's precise value.

values.meaning: shared queue/cast time applying to all casts
values.binNote: No matching KSanteQ data value of 0.25 exists in the sheet; the queue time appears to be a separate/hardcoded engine constant not exposed among the listed data values.

mechanics.claim: The non-empowered active is not a projectile and applies instantly along a rectangle in the target direction.
mechanics.quote: Only the empowered active is a {{tip|projectile}}.

mechanics.claim: Ntofo Strikes resets K'Sante's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Ntofo Strikes {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: If the cast hits at most one enemy champion, K'Sante is automatically ordered to attack that champion.
mechanics.quote: If ''Ntofo Strikes'' hits no more than one enemy champion, '''K'Sante''' will be ordered an attack command against them.

mechanics.claim: Hitting at least one enemy grants a stack lasting 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 and refreshing on subsequent hits; at 2 stacks the next cast is empowered and consumes all stacks.
mechanics.quote: If this hits at least one enemy, '''K'Sante''' generates a {{tip|stack}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Ntofo Strikes'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.

mechanics.claim: While in All Out, Ntofo Strikes no longer slows enemies hit, and its stacks are reset upon entering All Out; if K'Sante had 2 stacks before entering All Out, the cooldown is also reset.
mechanics.quote: Upon entering ''All Out'', ''Ntofo Strikes' '' stacks are reset. ''Ntofo Strikes' '' {{sti|cooldown}} is reset if '''K'Sante''' had 2 stacks before entering ''All Out''.

mechanics.claim: Temporary changes to bonus resistances affect Ntofo Strikes' cooldown and cast time in real time.
mechanics.quote: Temporary increases/decreases in bonus resistances will count for reducing/increasing ''Ntofo Strikes''' cooldown.
